# nyczips <img src="man/figures/nyczips.png" align="right" width="360">

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/kjhealy/nyczips/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kjhealy/nyczips/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![R-universe version](https://kjhealy.r-universe.dev/nyczips/badges/version)](https://kjhealy.r-universe.dev/nyczips)
<!-- badges: end -->


**Superseded.** Use the [nycmaps](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycmaps/)
package instead. The two objects this package used to provide are in
nycmaps, with the same contents:

- `nycmaps::nyc_zips`: New York City ZIP codes by borough, county, and post
  office.
- `nycmaps::nyc_zip_sf`: ZIP code tabulation area polygons with 2019 ACS
  population, in EPSG:2263 (the copy formerly here was in EPSG:4269).

They were removed from nyczips in version 0.0.1.9001 so that loading both
packages no longer masks one copy with the other.

```r
library(nycmaps)

nyc_zip_sf
```
